v17-26.candidate: They told the king of the Assyrians, ‘The nations you deported and resettled in Samaria’s cities do not know the judgment of the God of the land. He has sent lions among them, and behold, they are killing them, because they do not know the judgment of the God of the land.’

v17-34.candidate: To this day they acted according to their judgment. They fear, and they act according to their ordinances, their judgment, the law, and the commandment which the Lord commanded the sons of Jacob, whom He named Israel.
v17-34.close: To this day they acted according to their judgment. They fear, and they act according to their ordinances, their judgment, the law, and the commandment which the Lord commanded Jacob’s sons, whom He named Israel.

v17-39.candidate: But you shall fear only the Lord your God, and He will rescue you from all your enemies.
